reviewContext.issueReference: tacogips/ccusage-gauge (inline workflow input; no issue number supplied; workflowExecutionId gemini-neon-terra-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-958)
reviewContext.userProblem: The Swift menubar + Swift AppCore + Tauri v2 dashboard split requires both Swift and Rust toolchains and invokes external ccusage CLI subprocesses on multi-GB local session logs every 20 seconds. Migrate the entire application to pure Rust + Tauri v2 with zero Swift code, native Tauri v2 macOS template tray icon/title/live menu, and an incremental Rust JSONL usage/pricing/blocks engine.
requiredOutcomes: Single root Cargo workspace (crates/ccusage-core, crates/ccusage-cli, src-tauri) with one locked Cargo.lock and zero Swift code or SwiftPM files remaining.

Single-process Tauri v2 macOS menu-bar tray + embedded SolidJS dashboard (ccusage-gauge-app) rendering RGBA template tray icons via TrayIcon::set_icon_with_as_template (area-proportional fill logos for Claude, Codex, and Gemini, budget pie/warning icon, inline ratio percentages, anti-flicker change detection), cost title via TrayIcon::set_title, live dropdown menu updates via MenuItem::set_text, native settings/dialogs, and macOS Launch at Login via pure-Rust objc2 SMAppService FFI.

Native Rust incremental byte-offset JSONL scanner for Claude Code (~/.claude/projects), Codex (~/.codex/sessions), and Antigravity (~/.gemini/antigravity-cli) tracking (fileSize, modified, scannedThrough, boundary) with reuse/resume/rescan and zero local ccusage CLI invocations or hard-link mirroring.

Exact decimal Rust USD pricing engine using daily-refreshed cached LiteLLM pricing JSON (~/.cache/ccusage-gauge/litellm-pricing.json) plus built-in fallback table, 5m/1h cache-creation rates, above-200k tiers, and Antigravity date-effective schedules.

Local 5-hour billing blocks (regenerative BlockAnchor reconstruction + cold/warm parity), daily metrics, 15-minute session buckets, and exact half-open [start, end) rolling-window totals backed by compatible SQLite UsageAggregationCache (preserving legacy Swift-era caches and cached-only history).

Full parity for rate-limit fetchers (Claude Keychain/credentials, Codex auth/JSONL fallback, Gemini agy PTY), remote SSH ccusage collection and machine registry v3, MachineDashboardRouter (/api/* routes, Tauri IPC dashboard_request, loopback HTTP server), ccusage-gauge CLI subcommands and exit codes, bootstrap JSONL logging, and on-disk compatibility under ~/.config/ccusage-gauge, ~/.local/ccusage-gauge, and ~/.cache/ccusage-gauge.

Updated mise.toml, smoke/Homebrew Formula & Cask packaging scripts, Linux amd64 CI workflow, Docker emulation collector image, and repository documentation (AGENTS.md, README.md, llms.txt, packaging/homebrew/README.md) with frontend/ preserved intact.
nonGoals: Do not modify the SolidJS frontend/ source code or its /api/* and dashboard_request IPC wire contracts.
Do not replace remote SSH machine collection's remote ccusage CLI invocation over SSH.
Do not implement OAuth token refresh for Claude or Codex rate limits.
Do not commit .riela/, tmp/, or Cargo target/ build artifacts; workers must not run git commit/push/branch/reset operations.
constraints: Preserve exact on-disk paths, 0700/0600 permissions, camelCase JSON schemas, SQLite schemas, and CCUSAGE_GAUGE_{HOME,CONFIG_HOME,STATE_HOME,CACHE_HOME} precedence (always appending ccusage-gauge/ under each *_HOME override).
Keep all Rust source files under 1000 lines, rustfmt clean, and cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings clean.
Pin all workspace dependencies in Wave 1 (rust-01-workspace-foundation) so subsequent waves run with --locked without mutating Cargo.lock.
Keep crates/ccusage-cli free of Tauri, AppKit, and WebKit linkage so headless Linux amd64 builds and Docker emulation containers remain lightweight.
Preserve AGENTS.md response rules, no-emoji rule, and git commit policy (no AI tool attribution or co-authorship in commit messages).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Single root Cargo workspace with three crates (crates/ccusage-core, crates/ccusage-cli, src-tauri) and one root Cargo.lock.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Eliminates duplicate dependency resolution, enables parallel Wave 2 development without Cargo.lock contention, and keeps ccusage-cli headless for Linux amd64 and Docker builds.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Single-process Tauri v2 tray + dashboard app (ccusage-gauge-app) replacing the Swift-to-Tauri stdin/stdout pipe bridge and nested CCUsageGaugeDashboard.app helper.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Removes IPC serialization/process-management overhead and simplifies both Homebrew Formula and signed/notarized Cask packaging while preserving dashboardAutostart and --dashboard-only CLI launch semantics.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Separate 15-minute chart bucketing from exact half-open [interval.start, interval.end) rolling-window totals with a pinned single-day active-boundary scan slot for long customHours(n) windows.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Prevents 15-minute flooring from dropping in-window events or including expired events while keeping steady-state 20-second polls append-only / zero-reread even for multi-week rolling windows.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Regenerative BlockAnchor checkpoint at retention_floor for 5-hour billing blocks.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Guarantees cold-cache, warm-cache, restart, narrow, and expanded queries produce identical 5-hour block starts and costs without re-scanning unchanged historical logs on steady-state polls.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Additive local-only antigravity_coverage_ranges table and strict token-total conservation for legacy Swift-era UsageAggregationCache provenance backfill.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Preserves cached-only Claude/Codex history whose raw logs may be gone, backfills historical Antigravity rows idempotently, and prevents partial-log rescans from undercounting or duplicating legacy totals.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Internal Tauri custom-URI dialogs (ccusage-dialog://localhost/...) for tray budget, custom hours, refresh interval, and display settings.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Provides native tray configuration UX in pure Rust + Tauri v2 without modifying frontend/.

intentionalTradeoffs: GUI WindowServer launch checks (dashboardAutostart true/false and ccusage-gauge dashboard --dashboard-only window close) are manual/environment-gated when running in headless sandboxes, backed by automated CLI, IPC, and tray-state unit tests.
Crate-wide and workspace-wide cargo clippy gates run in serial join waves (rust-09, rust-10, rust-13, rust-14) rather than parallel Wave 2/Wave 5 leaves to avoid sibling-module lint interference.
supportedEdgeCases: Truncated, replaced, or in-place-edited JSONL files trigger boundary mismatch detection and clean rescan; appended-only logs resume from scannedThrough with zero historical prefix reads.
Codex bounded reverse scan resolves pre-cutoff turn_context lines for in-range token_count events while preserving newest_model/newest_effort for subsequent forward append-resume.
Offline or first-run pricing falls back cleanly from daily LiteLLM cache to built-in model rates and $0 for unknown models while retaining token counts.
Legacy Swift-era aggregates-local.sqlite3 with partial or absent raw logs preserves authoritative cached daily/session totals without duplication or unsupported directory attribution.
CCUSAGE_GAUGE_DESKTOP_EXECUTABLE set (even to empty or missing path) fails closed with exit 1 and sanitized diagnostic without falling back to sibling binary lookup.
Disabling all local session sources produces an empty healthy snapshot; missing or non-directory local roots are skipped without error.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Windows native tray or Windows Launch at Login support.
Replacing remote SSH ccusage CLI execution with remote JSONL streaming.
Changing SolidJS dashboard UI layout, styling, or chart specifications.
